User Data Deletion Instructions

In accordance with Meta Platform policies, users have the right to request deletion of their data collected by Navii AI.

How to Request Data Deletion

You can request complete deletion of your conversation data through any of the following methods:

  1. Automatic In-Chat Deletion:

    In any direct message conversation with Navii, type /delete-my-data, Forget me, or Reset conversation. All active memory and session logs tied to your user ID will be permanently cleared from the active database immediately.

  2. Email Request:

    Send an email to dhruvsagar693@gmail.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request - Navii" and provide your Instagram handle or user ID. Your data will be deleted within 48 hours, and a confirmation email will be sent to you.

  3. Remove App Permissions via Instagram:

    You can remove Navii's permissions at any time via your Instagram App: Settings ➔ Security ➔ Apps and Websites ➔ Active ➔ Select Navii AI and click Remove.

Confirmation Code

Upon processing any deletion request, your identifier is completely erased from all session caches and persistent storage logs.
